$$\begin{array}{ll} \text{I.} & m\angle AOB = m\angle DOC \\ \text{II.} & m\angle AOB = 2m\angle DEC \\ \text{III.} & m\angle DOC = \frac{1}{2}m\angle DEC \end{array}$$

Therefore, I and II are correct.
